query: spindle pretravel 这个参数我想彻底搞明白：它到底定义的是什么？为什么初始化后头几片的厚度全靠它？取值多少合适、怎么测定、测完还要做什么，一口气给我捋清楚。
gold_standard: （1）定义：为防止假开关信号，机器须在触发校准开关前将柱塞压下一定距离，该距离即 Spindle Pretravel；它是机器初始化时使用的参数，不做该补偿则初始化后晶圆会被磨得过薄，因此恒为正值（用于增大晶圆厚度）。（2）两大作用：1) 保证初始化后立即磨削晶圆的厚度精度（最小化误差补偿）；2) 精确校准粗轮位置以优化双磨循环性能。（3）建议范围 45-70 微米，宜用千分尺调整到该区间；千分尺头朝校准开关方向旋入会增大所需 pretravel。（4）测定：在未加误差/轮磨损补偿前（Actual 与 Offset 坐标相同）标定机器，用与生产粗磨相同的参数以粗轮单磨两片，grind error = programmed thickness - actual thickness，误差为正增大 pretravel、为负减小；多片测量偏差不应超过 5 微米，过大说明进给率过高。（5）测完：修改 pretravel 数据后机器必须重新初始化，且该补偿仅在初始化时实施。

--[p113]-- In order to prevent false switch signals the machine should depress the plunger a certain distance before tripping the switch. This distance is defined as "Spindle Pretravel".
Spindle Pretravel is a machine parameter that is used during machine initialization. Without this compensation a wafer would be ground too thin after initialization (therefore it is always a positive value to increase the wafer thickness).
--[p113]-- Spindle Pretravel compensation provides two important functions: 1) to provide thickness accuracy for wafers ground immediately after machine initialization (minimizes error compensation and 2) to accurately calibrate coarse wheel position for optimizing dual grind cycle performance.
--[p113]-- A desirable range for pretravel is 45-70 microns. It is best to use the micrometer adjustment to obtain a pretravel value in this range for initialization. Screwing the micrometer head up toward the calibration switch will increase the required pretravel value.
--[p114]-- grind error = programmed thickness - actual thickness
If the grind error is positive increase the Spindle Pretravel value by the error; if negative decrease the value. Using multiple wafers for the test will produce an average for more stable results. Multiple wafer measurements should not vary by more than 5 microns. If larger differences result then feed rates may be excessive for the grind wheels and/or wafer product.

query: 双磨循环里粗轮和精轮的位置校准各是靠哪个参数兜底的？为什么手册强调 dynamic offset 的测试必须等 pretravel 调准、且在加误差/轮磨损补偿之前做？这两项补偿各自在什么时机生效？
gold_standard: Spindle Pretravel 用于初始化时精确校准粗轮位置；Dynamic Offset 以粗轮位置为基准，对精轮做附加校准。Dynamic Offset 补偿两种情况：1) 两轮直径不同，机械挠曲可能造成标定差异；2) 两轮磨削特性（磨削动力学）不同需要补偿。测试顺序原因：dynamic offset 测量须在实际生产参数的双磨循环下进行，且只有 pretravel 先调准，粗轮基准才可靠；同时与 pretravel 一样，dynamic offset 的测定只能在未施加任何误差或轮磨损补偿之前进行。生效时机：两者（dynamic offset 补偿）均仅在机器初始化时实施，修改 dynamic offset 数据后机器必须重新初始化。
success_criteria: 答出 pretravel 校准粗轮、dynamic offset 以其为基准校准精轮、dynamic offset 的两种补偿原因、须先调 pretravel 且在无补偿前测试、仅在初始化时生效并须重新初始化
evidence:
--[p115]-- The dynamic offset provides a function similar to the Spindle Pretravel. Spindle Pretravel provides for precise calibration of the coarse wheel position during machine initialization. Dynamic Offset is used to provide additional calibration for the finish wheel using the coarse wheel position as a reference.
--[p115]-- Dynamic Offset provides compensation for two conditions: 1) since each wheel is of different diameter mechanical deflections may cause differences in calibration and 2) the different grinding properties of each wheel may require compensation for differences in grinding dynamics.
--[p116]-- A dual grind cycle is required for dynamic offset measurement with all parameters set for the actual production dual grind cycle. Once the Spindle Pretravel has been accurately adjusted a dual grind cycle should be used to grind two wafers.
--[p115]-- As with Spindle Pretravel the test for determining Dynamic Offset should only be performed before any error or wheel wear compensation has been applied.
--[p116]-- After modifying dynamic offset data the machine must be reinitialized.
Dynamic offset compensation is only implemented during machine initialization.

query: 一批来料最厚 620 微米，工艺定粗磨目标 520 微米、最终 500 微米。按手册的自动计算规则，粗磨段的 rapid feed thickness 应该是多少？粗磨段和精磨段各自要磨掉多少微米？
gold_standard: rapid feed thickness = final wafer thickness + 2 microns = 500 + 2 = 502 微米（粗磨与精磨菜单的该参数均按同一公式自动计算）。粗磨段去除量 = 最大进给厚度 - 粗磨目标厚度 = 620 - 520 = 100 微米；精磨段去除量 = 粗磨目标厚度 - 最终厚度 = 520 - 500 = 20 微米；总去除量 = 620 - 500 = 120 微米。

query: 标定做了两轮：先按生产参数用粗轮单磨，设定 500 微米实测 504 微米；pretravel 调好后又跑双磨验证，设定 500 微米实测 497 微米。这两轮各自该调哪个参数、调多少、往哪个方向调？
gold_standard: 第一轮（单磨粗轮，调 Spindle Pretravel）：grind error = programmed thickness - actual thickness = 500 - 504 = -4 微米，误差为负，Spindle Pretravel 应减小 4 微米。第二轮（双磨，调 Dynamic Offset）：grind error = 500 - 497 = +3 微米，误差为正，Dynamic Offset 应增大 3 微米。两项补偿均仅在机器初始化时实施，修改后机器都必须重新初始化；多次测量间偏差不应超过 5 微米。
success_criteria: 答出 pretravel 减小 4 微米（500-504=-4）、dynamic offset 增大 3 微米（500-497=+3），方向判断正确且说明修改后须重新初始化
